A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the most favourable results were achieved for the following SPE/TLC conditions: (1) the use of a 1.5 g of C-18 sorbent; (2) the elution with 2 ml of methanol; (3) the evaporation under a stream of nitrogen; (4) the use of methanol as a solvent for the mobile phase.
the most important factor influencing the profile quality is the amount of sample loaded.
the proposed method of profiling is a simple, rapid, sensitive and selective method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to obtain good quality profiles of PMMA in a relatively short time (ca. 30 min) using a simple and low cost method.
the best profile is obtained by the use of 1 mL of methanol as the mobile phase, 10 mL of 0.1 M sodium carbonate solution as the eluent and 1 mL of 0% (w/v) sodium chloride solution as the modifier.
the quality of the impurity profile is strongly dependent on the choice of the eluent.
